label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 61
title: MVP: delete project -> 7-day restorable archive + reminder before permanent deletion
body: UI: deleting a project moves it to an 'Archived' state for 7 days (restorable), instead of permanent deletion. Show remaining days; allow Restore. Display a warning/reminder (in-app + email if enabled) 1-2 days before permanent deletion, and at delete time. After 7 days the backend permanently deletes it. Depends on backend BI-0072.
